question: Can a widened critical-chain, lock-chain, setup-class and block-swap proposal space beat a strong 128-operation start beyond an equally budgeted hand proposer?
hand_control: one calibrated compiled mixed-decoder search, seed 79, at most 512 exact proposals and 250 ms after the same strong start
oracle: best feasible plan from up to three exhaustive passes over the frozen block proposal families, starting from the same strong plan
live_gate: initial calibration start and fresh start, hand and oracle plans in actual HeROsim; independent plan and completion audit even after offline NO-GO
decision: Train no model unless median fresh oracle gain over strong start is at least 8 percent, median equal-budget hand capture is below 50 percent, and actionable graph residual survives strong hand features.
